completion:
Visit this link: https://www.osha.gov/tracking-reporting-workplace-injuries-illnesses. Click on the Forms tab to download the forms you need.

To get the documentation process started, be sure to include the following information on the Open Memorial Medical Center Accident/Injury Report:

*   Patient name (if stated on the employee's incident report)
*   Date of hospital visit from the patient, the patient's date of birth, and Social Security number or other identifiers.
*   Whether the injury/illness was caused by a fall.
*   Whether it was caused by being struck by or against an object.
*   Whether it was caused by overexertion.
*   Whether any objects fell on the patient's body.
*   Whether the patient was performing an emergency service that exposed them to tuberculosis and their response.
